promotions_window_chk.name: promotions_window_chk
promotions_window_chk.value: "promotions"."starts_at" is null or "promotions"."ends_at" is null or "promotions"."starts_at" < "promotions"."ends_at"

special_hours_shape_chk.name: special_hours_shape_chk
special_hours_shape_chk.value:
("special_hours"."is_closed" and "special_hours"."opens_at" is null and "special_hours"."closes_at" is null)
          or (not "special_hours"."is_closed" and "special_hours"."opens_at" is not null and "special_hours"."closes_at" is not null and "special_hours"."opens_at" < "special_hours"."closes_at")
